scope: host emulator / original MIT controlled NROM-256 cartridge
oracle: assembler output, checker only; never passed into production tracer/probe

conditions.serializedParity: every executed oracle instruction, every defined frame, external write, NMI, save/load and reset boundary: entire core.toJSON() SHA256 plus emitted audio/video stream hashes and NES frame counter
conditions.outputHash: all emitted 256x240 RGB pixels encoded as little-endian uint32; all stereo samples as little-endian float64
conditions.timing: nearest-rank wall-time p50/p95/p99; paired AB/BA balanced order, equal restored start states, warmup excluded; raw frames retained; serialization and hash checks outside timed sections
conditions.limitations: host Node timing only; short controlled cartridge workload, not browser/WebView, game generalization, physical Android, battery or an energy/performance-improvement claim
